## Problem

What problem does this feature solve? Who is affected?

## Proposed Solution

Describe the feature you'd like. Be as specific as possible.

## Alternatives Considered

What alternatives did you consider? Why is your proposal better?

## Additional Context

Any mockups, references, or related issues.

## Impact

How many users would benefit? Is this Egyptian-specific or broadly useful?
